definitions.explanation: Fixed or required by law. Used almost only as the first part of compounds such as {法定速度|ほうていそくど} (legal speed limit) and {法定労働時間|ほうていろうどうじかん} (statutory working hours).

examples.japanese: {法定速度|ほうていそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: to keep to the legal speed limit

examples.japanese: {法定労働時間|ほうていろうどうじかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{八時間|はちじかん}だ。
examples.english: The statutory working day is eight hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一般道|いっぱんどう}→一般道：16449_ippandou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{標識|ひょうしき}→標識：15865_hyoushiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{法定速度|ほうていそくど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧{六十|ろくじゅう}⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧だ。
examples.english: On ordinary roads without speed signs, the legal limit is 60 km/h.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {法定速度|ほうていそくど}: legal speed limit (when no sign gives another)
- {法定労働時間|ほうていろうどうじかん}: statutory working hours
- {法定相続人|ほうていそうぞくにん}: legal heir
- {法定代理人|ほうていだいりにん}: legal representative, such as a parent for a minor
- {法定伝染病|ほうていでんせんびょう}: (former term) legally designated infectious disease

WATCH OUT:
⟦{法廷|ほうてい}→法廷：15113_houtei⟧ (courtroom, court) has the same reading. {法定|ほうてい} is about what the law sets; ⟦{法廷|ほうてい}→法廷：15113_houtei⟧ is the place where trials are held.
